The '''language''' of the [[Carosite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was influenced by their medical heritage. It was rife with medical metaphors that were commonly used to describe [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] politics, [[Galactic economy|business]] deals, and other non-medical areas of life.
